rejected_rule.statement: A fidei commissum was created by the will of Kungiliyapodi Vanniya, and fiduciarii could not alienate more than their limited interest without proper Court proceedings.
rejected_rule.supporting_quote: "This appears to be a request to his sons to hold in trust, without any power of alienation, the immovable property and buffaloes; ... and this I understand to be what is known as a fidei commissum or trust"
